mirrors.description: The Aggregator's list of Mirrors it knows to re-serve the Log. Bootstrap convenience, never a trust root: WIST-3 §5 has the Consumer retain Mirror URLs from other sources too, because a list the Aggregator curates is the wrong sole source for the parties meant to catch it equivocating.

items.description: A Mirror's base URL: https, and ending in `/` so that a Consumer resolves Log paths against it by concatenation rather than by a join rule two implementations could differ on.
